title: 3366. Minimum Array Sum

examples.explanation: Apply Operation 2 to nums[1] = 8, making nums[1] = 5. Apply Operation 1 to nums[3] = 19, making nums[3] = 10. The resulting array becomes [2, 5, 3, 10, 3], which has the minimum possible sum of 23 after applying the operations.

Apply Operation 1 to nums[0] = 2, making nums[0] = 1. Apply Operation 1 to nums[1] = 4, making nums[1] = 2. Apply Operation 2 to nums[2] = 3, making nums[2] = 0. The resulting array becomes [1, 2, 0], which has the minimum possible sum of 3 after applying the operations.
